hypothesis: Five-frame motion and existing secondary appearance improve joint cut-and-reconnect decisions over the original probability alone without damaging division structure.
supplemental_protocol: Fixed-rule video-grouped discovery/confirmation screen; no training or threshold selection. Within each specimen sort video IDs; first four are discovery, last four confirmation. Report both specimens separately as transfer stress panels, not fitted leave-specimen-out validation.
candidate_policy: All exported final-node candidates for every source, without GT access. Keep top eight original probabilities per source plus all existing graph edges. Context is computed on the frozen parent graph from t-2,t-1,t,t+1,t+2, when two unbranched predecessors and one unbranched successor exist. Missing context contributes zero; same pool in both arms.
objective: Original utility is max(0,logit(probability)-logit(exported threshold)). Context adds 0.5*secondary_cosine - 0.5*min(motion_residual_um/7,2) only with complete motion context. Maximize sum utility minus 0.25 per added or removed edge; retaining a current edge is explicitly rewarded. Joint maximum-weight bipartite assignment per frame with private no-edge dummies. Reject symmetric-difference components containing no addition or nonpositive objective gain.
protection: Freeze existing fork parents and children and every current edge touching them. Freeze current edges absent from cache, and original-probability >=0.9 edges with unique best outgoing probability. Preserve their outgoing/incoming slots. No new forks: new decisions have at most one child; existing two-child forks are retained. Nodes, coordinates, detector, weights and EMA unchanged.
scoring: Reuse the frozen scorer and node matching, valid because nodes and coordinates are unchanged. Recompute complete graph edge/division metrics and aggregation weights. Log every action's additions/removals/objective. Label edits using frozen scorer semantics: TP, annotation-supported FP, unknown. Unknown is never converted into negative evidence.
stopping_rule: One fixed screen only. No post-result weight/threshold sweep. A failed gate stops remote advancement for this policy; it does not disprove all context methods.
limitations: Train16 backbone exposure and prior analysis prevent independent generalization claims.
Sparse annotations leave many edits unknown.
Five-frame geometry uses parent-smoothed coordinates and two-frame appearance embeddings; no learned five-frame encoder.
Frozen-parent context does not reflect sequential recomputation after edits.
No new forks or nodes are created; headroom is narrower than the GT oracle.
remote: Only after a successful local gate and fresh experiment-specific Claude PASS plus smoke may one bounded remote validation be prepared under the user's accepted plan. No leaderboard submission or promotion is authorized.
integrity_amendment: Before any aggregate evaluation: original candidate IDs must have unchanged frame identity and remain present through every exported stage. Reject IDs removed and reused by recovery. Failed attempt retained; utility parameters, panels and gates unchanged.
